newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-DOLPHINS TOP PICK WR GREEN OUT FOR YEAR WITH KNEE INJURY.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-DOLPHINS TOP PICK WR GREEN OUT FOR YEAR WITH KNEE INJURY.

text.p: The Miami Dolphins announced Friday that wide receiver Yatil Green, the team's first-round pick in the 1997 NFL draft, will miss the season with a torn ligament in his right knee.
Green suffered the injury in practice Thursday at the team's training camp in Davie, Florida.
An MRI Friday revealed the torn ACL in the right knee. Green is expected to undergo surgery next week.
"I'm very disappointed, I was looking forward to my first year in the league, but now I'll have to do everything possible ... to get ready for next year," said Green.
Green was the 15th overall selection after leaving the University of Miami following his junior year. He caught 42 passes for the Hurricanes last season for 669 yards and three touchdowns.

Green is the second Dolphins' receiver in as many years to suffer a serious knee injury during training camp. Fred Barnett tore cartilage in his right knee and had surgery last August but made a remarkable comeback after missing only six regular-season games.
The Dolphins also announced that linebacker Larry Izzo, a special teams standout, suffered a torn left Achilles' tendon during practice Friday morning and will require surgery.
